aspects.description: Reviews on fabric touch, thickness, material quality, pilling, fading, or lining issues like fleece missing.
Feedback on whether items run true to size, fit well, or have correct dimensions (sleeves, length, waist).
Comments on loose threads, stitching durability, tearing, or overall garment construction quality.
Issues regarding color discrepancy, wrong item shipped, or incorrect description (e.g. fleece vs thin version).
Opinions on whether the price is reasonable, affordable, or represents good value for money.
Feedback on shipping speed, courier attitude, and delivery notification handling.
Evaluations of seller responsiveness, customer support, and return/exchange processing time.
